historic_survey.note: Crocker Tower, now Post Montgomery Center, by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill. It has the rectangular form of a typical Late Modernist high-rise but introduces pattern and ornament to its polished granite facade; with the Galleria it marks the arrival of Postmodernism downtown.

building.name: Crocker Tower
building.completed_conflict: The city's Modern & Postmodern styles context statement dates this building 1982; the assessor's roll records it as built 1980.
